args.body: Use the committed current NLnet call, funding terms and 10/10 CSV baseline. If the decisive unresolved point is applicant responsibility for disclosed AI-assisted work, capture the exact wording and distinguish eligibility evidence from the technical work. Reuse any completed milestone sample. Otherwise, if the published project scope supports the CSV tool, run one measurable milestone acceptance case and save it with a conditional proposal draft or the exact reason a proposal would be unsuitable. Read back the artifacts and close the bounded mission under valid ownership with a lesson. No submission or spend.

description: The SQLite package ran successfully from a clean directory and produced the expected result. The bilingual listing draft is saved. The Canadian processor fetch was refused, so Payhip activation still depends on readable first-party terms confirming Canadian seller eligibility, fees and a compatible payout method. The downloadable package can be tested independently. Available commercial feedback shows no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Treasury is unfunded and reports no verified revenue.
